sweep.title: Membership sweep (2026-10-01)
sweep.text: Every NPC in Skyrim, Update, Dawnguard, HearthFires, Dragonborn and the CC packs that carries the `ActorTypeGhost` keyword 0D205E, a ghost ability spell (`GhostAbility` 05030B, `GhostAbilityNew` 0D2056 and the Fire, Frost, Storm, Violet and half-damage variants) or a ghost script, through templates; plus every record with Ghost, Spirit, Spectre, Wraith or Phantom in its EditorID or name. Hostile means aggressive or in a faction that is an enemy of the player. Re-checked 2026-11-12 (keyword, ability and EditorID): nothing new. Everything hostile is on a family page except the following.
